text.en:
1. This Ordinance may be cited as the Counterfeit
Coin Ordinance, 1957.           |

|

2. In this Ordinance—

"counterfeit" has the meaning assigned to it by the
Penal Coded

(dg           *. 99              t.
current coin" means any coin made by law a legal
tender in the Federation.

3. (1) Where any coin is tendered as current coin to
any person who suspects the} same to be diminished
otherwise than by reasonable wear or to be counterfeit,
such person may cut, break, bend or deface such coin.

(2) If any coin so cut, broken, bent or defaced appears
to be diminished otherwise than by reasonable wear,
or to be counterfeit, the person tendering the same shall
bear the loss thereof.

(3) If the same is of due weight and appears to be
lawful coin, the person cuttin}  , breaking, bending or
defacing the same shall receive the same at its face value.

(4) If any dispute arises Pa the coin so cut,
broken, bent or defaced is diminished in manner afore-
said or counterfeit, it may be heard and finally deter-
mined in a summary manner by a Magistrate's Court
which is hereby empowered to examine upon oath as
well the parties as any other person in order to the
decision of the dispute.

(5) Every public officer, to whom i in the performance
of his duties there is tendered ii in payment of any part
of the revenue of any Government in the Federation or
presented for inspection or otherwise any coin which
appears to be a counterfeit of! current coin or to have
been unlawfully diminished, shall cut, break or deface
or cause to be cut, broken or defaced every such coin.

COUNTERFEIT COIN                     243

4, The Counterfeit Coin Enactment of the Federated Repeal
Malay States and the Counterfeit Coin Ordinance of Cap 122,
the Straits Settlements are hereby repealed.            SS. Cap.
